about: What the daily paper watcher (scripts/watch.js) looks for on arXiv. Queries use arXiv's search syntax (https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html). The watcher asks once a day, one request every 3 seconds (arXiv's limit), newest first. 'people' searches the ontology watchlist by author name; it is off by default and matches names only, never claims. Twitter/X is never a source.
